notes.title: Full Release Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Version 1.0 is out now![/p][p]First of all, I would like to thank the awesome community. Thank you so much for your ideas, suggestions, and feedback. It helped me a lot in this journey :)[/p][previewyoutube="hYNHMx9mBWQ;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][u]Your save files are fine![/u][/h3][p]Your current save files are fully compatible with the full version.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/a974fd32088faa09d354d89fe548954b439d654a.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][h3][u]Here are the new features and content in v1.0[/u][/h3][h1]1- Cigarette Vending Machine[/h1][p]As you can see, there is a cigarette vending machine in front of the store.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/007bf667a67284469dd968f0e3d3fefa1f9a5114.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can purchase it in the Desktop-Cigarette Vending Machine section when you reach the required store level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/37dbb11572a4fd5096d60589820350191651ebf5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][u]This machine is active day and night.[/u][/p][list][*][p][i]Day Time Sales:[/i] You get the money immediately if any cigarette is sold during the day.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Night Time Sales:[/i] You get the money from the night sales in the early morning. Night sales depend on how many different product types you provide in the vending machine. In other words, more product types, more income.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/1f3ef827f63c53a1d06788ba14751b97e2e1bd36.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]You get a notification on the left side of the screen showing you the previous night's sales.[/i][/p][p][i]No level points are coming from the cigarette vending machine.[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]2- Discount Event[/h1][p]When you set a discount event, it'll start the next day and last a day. During the discount event, you should be ready for about 30% more customers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/4903ab6b282517788122fac7918964a22187a708.png"][/img][/p][p]You can see how many days are left until the next discount date on your Desktop-Discount Event. It's also written on the corner of the discount event icon on the desktop.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/815ca6a3c02a93ffb45721ab651106494916a8d0.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The discount percentage will be automatically applied to all products in your store.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]If you sign a new contract during the discount event, new product prices will automatically be adapted to the discount percentage.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You can't change any prices during the discount event.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Online orders won't be affected by the discount event.  [/p][/*][/list][h1]3- Spray Paints[/h1][p]You can purchase spray paints in the Desktop-Spray Paint section.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/ead0274e86c71d0f943073db8d6f39da8d29546c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can purchase them anytime you want. [i](So it's possible to purchase after 10 pm.)[/i][/p][p]Your orders arrive at the back of the store as usual.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/a6c0af35b4bc50dffd88ef25bd3952b0d461a3d6.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]4- Ceiling Signs[/h1][p]You can buy ceiling signs in the Market-Equipment section.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/2f02ac893a6cdddc50ea92ceba933c34661adc90.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When you click on that after placing it on the ceiling, you can change its name, logo, text color, and background color.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/0df0ef6590e8832db2fe7a5ccdb873474829a85d.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]5- Profile - New Characters[/h1][p]Two new characters have been added to the Main Menu - Profile section.[/p][p]You can customize your character anytime in the Main Menu - Profile section.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/f52c387ba594f9b7450b4cb1e627283654f56f29.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/7f37fa323ad9393cbaa84bb7f00fd29f4ee2d455.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]6- New notes.title: Full Release on 22nd June!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Tobacco Shop Simulator is leaving Early Access on June 22nd!

Upcoming features in the full release:
1- Cigarette Vending Machine
2- Discount Events
3- Ceiling Signs
4- Spray Paints
5- Profile - New Characters (Extra 1 male and 1 female)
6- New Products and Contracts
7- New Racks
8- New Store Expansion
9- New Warehouse Expansion
10- New Decorations
11- New Self-Defense Bats
12- New Walls
13- New Floors
14- New Shopping Bags
15- New Computer/Tablet Wallpapers
16- New Soundtracks
17- New Store Logos
